attacks.name: Prowler Gauntlet Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Pierce|: Change 1 of the defender's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block| results to a Blank.
|!wild| |*Suppressive|: Before |!damage| is dealt, for each |!wild| in the attack roll, the defender loses 1 |!power|.

attacks.name: Covert Armament
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
The defender cannot modify its defense dice during this attack.

attacks.name: Nothing Personal, Just Business
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character may Advance |!movement_medium|.
|!wild| |*Throw|: Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, this character may Throw it |!movement_small|.

superPowers.name: Charge
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character immediately makes a move action followed by an attack action. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: You're Right, I Can Do Better
superPowers.body: When this character attacks, during the |*Modify Dice| step, it may use this superpower. This character may reroll all of its attack dice, including |!failure| results.

superPowers.name: Custom-Designed Burglar Gadgets
superPowers.body: The first time this character interacts with an objective each Turn, after the effect is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
